meta.name: Accounts Payable / Invoice Approval
meta.origin: kalita/frameworks — curated by Kalita Forge, reviewed by Architect Pro + Security Pro (product mission A)

vocabulary.meaning: Invoice issued by a supplier to the company for payment
Supplier — the counterparty that issued the invoice
Contract with the supplier against which the invoice is matched
Purchase order, if the company uses them
Handoff of an approved invoice to the payment system
Approval ladder by amount: different roles for different thresholds

entities.name: Invoice

fields.name: contract
fields.note: if the company matches invoices against contracts

entities.notes: unique(vendor, number, date) — first line of defense against duplicates

entities.name: PurchaseOrder
entities.notes: created only if the company has confirmed it uses POs

stages.what: an invoice enters the system with a source
checks duplicates (vendor+number+date), contract presence, details, amount; finding records instead of making refusals on its own
requires approval(Role) on confirm; the guard is rechecked by the engine in Decide (Cycle-003)
invoice.approved event → egress to Y; handoff record
rejection with a reason; return for rework

segregation_of_duties.rule: The role that enters the invoice (APClerk) does not approve it (no approve grant)
The agent checks but does not approve or pay — deny [approve *, delete *]
Changing the ladder thresholds — only via proposal + Owner signature

control_points.what: if contract matching is confirmed — an invoice without a valid contract blocks confirm
guard when amount ... routes to the right level
the engine rechecks the guard at signing (the amount may have changed after parking)
only from the approved state; the egress event is logged

kpis.label: Share of invoices with a finding from the agent

risks.mitigation: amount ladder instead of a single approval

required.question: What counts as an 'invoice to pay' in your company?
required.why: Without defining the object you cannot build the model: is it supplier invoices? work completion certificates? something else?

required.question: Who approves invoices?
required.why: Without an approver you cannot safely build the ladder — this is a blocking question

important.question: Are there amount thresholds, and who approves at each level?
important.default: a single approval by whoever was named in approval_authority
important.why: The ladder relieves the director; the default is safe, but thresholds are a typical best practice

important.question: Do you match invoices against contracts?
important.why: Changes the entities (Contract) and the control point

important.question: Do you use purchase orders (PO)?
important.why: Adds an entity and matching — only if actually used

important.question: Do you have department heads and a CFO?

optional.question: Do you pay in multiple currencies?
optional.why: Changes the currency field and amount matching; can be deferred

optional.question: Do you need VAT checks?
optional.why: Adds agent checks; can be deferred

optional.question: Do prepayments/overpayments under contracts occur?
optional.why: Affects contract matching; can be deferred

alternatives.tradeoffs: simple, but the director is a bottleneck; risks delays

alternatives.when: there are managers/CFO, a stream of invoices
alternatives.tradeoffs: balance of control/speed; slightly more roles
one more level for extreme amounts

anti_patterns.why: Entry and approval by the same person = loss of control (SoD)
The agent cannot be the authority over money — HITL is mandatory
Double payment is a classic AP loss
Approval without an amount condition = a lottery of whom to ask

regulatory.note: Tax/audit record-keeping requirements for primary documents — verify during implementation

automations.what: when an invoice appears, the agent gets a review task
an invoice stuck in a status escalates to defApprover
a reminder to the approver on inactivity (schedule/stuck)

approvals.note: thresholds come from discovery, not from the framework; the framework provides only the pattern

integrations.notes: system Y; webhook delivery — kernel gap D-011, show status honestly
